entities.summary: Henri-Jacques-Guillaume Clarke, 1st comte d'Hunebourg, 1st duc de Feltre, was a French military officer, diplomat, and politician of Irish origin who served as Minister of War of the First French Empire from 1807 to 1814. He was made a Marshal of France in 1816.
